verdict.rationale: Consensus is a SaaS research engine, so event-triggered rules or automations (for example, alerts on new papers) are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a REST API and MCP server for running searches programmatically. Those are developer building blocks a user could wire into their own automation, not a documented rule or trigger system in the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
